stories.title: Sources: Rays acquire Peralta in trade with Mets
stories.summary: The Rays are acquiring Freddy Peralta in a trade with the Mets, sources told ESPN, in a move that gives Tampa Bay one of the AL's best rotations for the stretch run.

stories.title: Dodgers win Skubal race, land Tigers ace in trade
stories.summary: The first-place Dodgers have finalized a trade to acquire two-time AL Cy Young Award winner Tarik Skubal from the Tigers, sending Zyhir Hope, River Ryan and Brady Smith to Detroit.

stories.title: Saints' Bresee to have season-ending ACL surgery
stories.summary: Saints defensive tackle Bryan Bresee will undergo season-ending surgery to repair a torn ACL, coach Kellen Moore told reporters Sunday.

stories.title: Skubal fights tears in emotional farewell to Tigers
stories.summary: An emotional Tarik Skubal recounted his nine seasons with the Tigers and said it was something he would "never take for granted" after it was reported that he was being traded to the Dodgers.

stories.title: Sources: Sparks trade All-Star Plum to Mercury
stories.summary: The Sparks are trading five-time All-Star Kelsey Plum to the Mercury for Monique Akoa Makani, a 2027 first-round pick and a 2028 second-rounder, sources told ESPN.
